# sonatyperepo_security_ssrf_protection (Resource)

Manage SSRF (Server-Side Request Forgery) Protection settings. As of Sonatype Nexus Repository 3.92, requests to private (RFC1918) addresses are blocked unless explicitly allowed here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sonatyperepo_security_ssrf_protection" "ssrf" {
  enabled = true
  allowed_domains = [
    "internal.example.com"
  ]
  allowed_ips = [
    "10.0.0.5"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether or not SSRF Protection is enabled

### Optional

- `allowed_domains` (Set of String) Domain names allowed to bypass SSRF Protection
- `allowed_ips` (Set of String) IP addresses allowed to bypass SSRF Protection

### Read-Only

- `last_updated` (String) String representation of the date/time the resource was last changed

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Existing SSRF Protection configuraiton can be imported as follows.
#
# NOTE: The Identifier (SSRF_PROTECTION) in below example has no meaning and is just to comply with Terraform syntax.

# Example
terraform import sonatyperepo_security_ssrf_protection.ssrf SSRF_PROTECTION
```
